description: This Java class implements a custom error decoder for Feign clients, handling and logging different HTTP error responses and extracting detailed error information from response bodies.

classes.name: CustomFeignErrorDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing Feign's ErrorDecoder interface to provide custom error handling for Feign client responses.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the Feign Response based on status code, logs errors, and returns appropriate Exceptions.

methods.name: extractBankingCoreGlobalException
methods.description: Extracts a SimpleBankingGlobalException object from the response body by parsing the response content.
